findings.issue: original_ids ignores production speech event.source and visual event.data, including valid numeric segment IDs, so indexed citations lose existing provenance.

Unvalidated chapter/event start and end values enter occurrences; a provider end such as 00:00:10 makes Ask fail while rendering context, and non-finite or reversed ranges can produce false timestamps.
Ask never forwards --min-similarity to either semantic or hybrid retrieval, so explicitly excluded evidence still reaches the answer model.
Degraded hybrid Ask replaces already-reranked hits with keyword results but retains rerank.applied=true and stale counts, discarding a paid ranking.
Hybrid candidate_k remains 60 even when the requested limit is higher, silently truncating eligible results.
Combining --index/embedding preparation with --search or --ask --json prints progress to stdout, making an exit-0 JSON result unparsable.
first_completed_at is exposed as a date filter but run_pipeline never writes or preserves it, so newly completed jobs remain unknown and are excluded.
Artifact hashing and parsing use separate reads; a concurrent writer can bind replacement text to the previous artifact's analysis_revision.
Context merging compares only the last range end; nested overlapping ranges split continuous evidence and can drop it under the per-job cap.
Missing or false-valued rerank results/data is treated as an empty successful ranking, falsely reporting applied=true for malformed provider output.
Migrating an old occurrences schema drops both lookup indexes after their initial creation and never recreates them.

needs-human: A5 requires partial analysis to be visible, but manifest.visual_status is absent from search hits and Ask evidence. Selecting an output-schema/status policy versus excluding incomplete evidence changes the public contract; left unchanged for human decision.

summary: Fixed 11 provenance/retrieval defects with regression tests proven red before repair; 118 Python tests (159 subtests) and 35 widget scenarios pass, and compilation/diff checks exit 0. The full suite has 467 passed, 20 failed and 14 skipped (exit 1); all failure IDs match the exact PR base. Needs-human: choose how partial analysis is exposed in search/Ask; A5 semantic support, A9 human evaluation and real embedding revision acceptance remain unverified, and no push was performed.
